faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment is 30th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III post at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Three Years Graduate degree in a relevant subject/field with three years of experience, or a PG degree in a relevant subject/field. For Engineering/IT/CS, a Four Years Graduate Degree is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support-III position is 35 years, with relaxation as per AIIMS/ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 28000 Per Month plus HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a Contract job type for the Project Technical Support-III position at AIIMS Delhi.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the links for the official notification and the online application form in the "Important Links" section of this article.
